theorem _root_.CompressionEval.smoke_la_02 {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℤ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0) :
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = 0 ∧ (∑ i ∈ s, (f i + g i)) = ∑ i ∈ s, g i :=
by
  constructor
  · exact Finset.sum_eq_zero h
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp [h i hi]
